messages.content: I've changed my mind, can I get a greens instead of what I previously ordered?

The user wants "greens" but the function only accepts those options. We need to respond appropriately. The user wants "greens" instead of what they previously ordered. We can interpret "greens" as "SALAD"? Possibly. But the function only accepts SALAD. We could respond that we can change to SALAD. Or we could ask for clarification. The user specifically says "greens". We can interpret that as "SALAD". We can respond that we will change to SALAD. Then call the function with TheFod: "SALAD". That is the only way to proceed. The user wants to change to "greens". We can interpret that as "SALAD". So we can call the function with SALAD.
